identity.name: BowlsManager Pro
identity.vibe: Heritage meets Precision. Think Wimbledon aesthetics with modern SaaS usability.
principles: Clarity under Pressure: Score entry must be instant and error-proof.
Visual Hierarchy: The Leaderboard is the hero.
Green is the Anchor: Use emerald tones to ground the design, but keep data on white.
Mobile First: Players are on the green, not at a desk.

headings.usage: Page titles, Tournament names, Winner announcements

data.usage: Scores, Skin points, Rink numbers, Time

spacing.scale: Tailwind default but doubled for 'Clubhouse' feel

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the emerald backgrounds to mimic grass texture.

ScoreCard.description: The core input mechanism. Must be large and touch-friendly.
ScoreCard.specs: Grid layout. 3 'Skin' sections. Auto-calculating totals. Big +/- buttons.

RinkMap.description: Visual representation of Green A and Green B.
RinkMap.specs: 2x6 Grid. Color-coded by status (Playing, Finished, Empty).

DrawGenerator.specs: Step-by-step wizard. Visual confirmation of 'No Repeats'.

images.description: Close up of bowls on green - Use for Landing Page Hero / Login Background
Trophy on grass - Use for Winner Modal / Leaderboard Header

assets.icons: Lucide React (Trophy, Users, Calendar, ChevronRight, Plus, Minus, Medal)

layout_strategies.dashboard: Control Room Grid: Sidebar nav, dense data tables, quick action cards top right.
layout_strategies.mobile_score: Single Column Stack: Header (Match Info) -> Skin 1 Input -> Skin 2 Input -> Skin 3 Input -> Submit.
layout_strategies.public_view: Tetris Grid: Hero Leaderboard (Top 3) + Recent Matches Feed + Upcoming Draw.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. SETUP TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Clubhouse' palette defined above.
3. COMPONENT LIBRARY: Use Shadcn for the 'shell' (Dialogs, Dropdowns, Tabs) but build custom 'Cards' for the specific Lawn Bowls needs (Scorecard, Rink).
4. ALGORITHM VISUALIZATION: When generating the draw, show a 'Loading/Calculating' state that explains 'Checking for repeat matchups...' to build trust.
5. MOBILE OPTIMIZATION: The 'Score Entry' page MUST be usable with one hand on a phone in bright sunlight (High Contrast).
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every input and button has a data-testid for testing.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Avoid 'Inter' for Headings - Use Playfair Display.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (text-emerald-700 -> text-emerald-900).
